_doc: Codex CLI hooks (experimental, v0.114+, March 2026). PreToolUse only matches the `Bash` tool; direct file writes via the agent's Write/Edit/MultiEdit are NOT hookable. On Windows Codex hooks are unavailable per the official docs; rely on AGENTS.md + Lefthook instead.
_enabling: Add `[features]\ncodex_hooks = true` to ~/.codex/config.toml, then both ~/.codex/hooks.json and this file run additively.

hooks._doc: Block bash commands that would rm/mv/redirect into docs/_archive/, AGENTS.md, or the progressive-disclosure index files. Exit 2 = block.
At AI turn end, remind the operator whether pre-commit / pre-push gates are still ahead. Informational only.
